{{infobox blank}}During the course of [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]], there are six possible girlfriends for [[Carl]], with two of them, [[Denise Robinson]] and [[Millie Perkins]], becoming girlfriends through the storyline. Dating any of the six girlfriends is not required for [[Completion in GTA San Andreas|100% Completion]] with the exception of Millie Perkins who can be killed on the first date to obtain a keycard for the ultimate heist mission, [[Breaking the Bank at Caligula's]].

Denise is first encountered during the mission [[Burning Desire]] for [[Frank Tenpenny]], whilst Millie first appears during the mission [[Key To Her Heart]] in [[Las Venturas]]. The remaining four girlfriends are [[Michelle Cannes]], [[Barbara Schternvart]], [[Helena Wankstein]], and [[Katie Zhan]].

| Denise is encountered during the mission [[Burning Desire]] and she lives a block away from Carl in [[Ganton]], [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]]. She is always available for Carl to hang out with, irrespective of his appearance. On a given date, she does not mind the player's wanted level, and loves to occasionally do [[Drive-By Shooting|drive-by]]s.

Denise is the easiest girlfriend to date in the game, and she rewards Carl with her [[Hustler]] at half-mark progress, while gifting him a [[Pimp Suit|pimp suit]] upon attaining 100% progress.

| [[Millie Perkins]]
| Millie is encountered during the mission [[Key to Her Heart]] and she lives in the [[Prickle Pine]] district of [[Las Venturas]]. She likes a physically fit appearance for a date. On a given one, she, like all other girlfriends, with the exception of Denise, abandons the date if the player has a [[Wanted Level in GTA III Era #Two-stars|wanted level of more than two stars]].

Millie is the most "unproductive" girlfriend in the game, as all of the potential rewards she could provide, with the exception of keys to her car, a pink [[Club]], can still be attained by killing her otherwise, including the card for the casino heist, success in which would also automatically reward the player with the croupier uniform she wears. Even the pink [[Club]] she owns can be otherwise obtained by stealing one of another colour and spraying it at [[Pay 'n' Spray|any of the]] [[Transfender|many spray shops]].

| [[Helena Wankstein]]
| Helena can first be found at the [[Ammu-Nation]] store in [[Blueberry]], [[Red County]] and she lives on a farm in [[Flint County]]. She too likes a physically fit appearance for a date. On a given one, she, like all other girlfriends, with the exception of Denise, abandons the date if the player has a [[Wanted Level in GTA III Era #Three-stars|wanted level of more than two stars]].

Unlike other girlfriends, Helena does not place any restrictions on Carl using the vehicles at her farm, which are always open [[The Green Sabre #Reward|after Flint County is unlocked]]. She rewards Carl with weapons in a tin shed at the farm when they are dating and gifts him a set of [[Rural Clothes|rural clothes]] upon attaining 100% progress.

== Tips & Glitches ==
: <small>'''Driving dates must be played by the rules, but for other date types, there are shortcuts:'''</small>
* Using a [[Maverick]] to take girlfriends out is helpful for some of the more secluded ones (Helena, Barbara), allowing you to complete a food or dance date before they get bored.
* Driving a motorcycle on a date pretty much gives you a free pass to drive recklessly. Carl can hit other cars, solid objects, fall/fly off the bike with his girlfriend, etc. and none of this will upset them. This also helps you reach distant dates before the girl gets bored. However, any "stunt" driving will get a complaint. 
: <small>'''(None of this is relevant for Katie, as she likes horrible driving)'''.</small>
* Sometimes a girlfriend will be absent from their house for over 24 hours. If this happens, [[Wasted|dying]], [[Busted|getting arrested]], or completing a mission seem to be the only ways to get them spawning for dates again.
* If the player has collected all the [[oysters]] in the game, Carl's sex appeal will be at its maximum; thus, the girlfriends wouldn't really care how Carl would look, making all dates possible. However, the wanted level constraint still holds, and would result in progress getting negative.

== Trivia == 
* On rare occasions, while the player is dating a girlfriend, he can be spotted by another girlfriend.<ref>[http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PXdjux3Fi60 Millie catches Carl cheating on Denise]</ref>
* If the player has collected all the [[oysters]] in the game, Carl can find all of his girlfriends, except Denise and Millie, again in their usual place where they first met, even though Carl had killed them or abandoned them.
* During [[Vigilante]], girlfriend models are sometimes used as criminals.<ref>[http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K_vpdjD2wL8 Denise model during Vigilante]</ref>
